data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'aldos' meaning 'old, wise' or 'helder' meaning 'noble, bright'. In Greek mythology, Aldis was an ancient god of the forest. The name Aldis carries the meaning “Old, wise” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Aldis usually hope their child will grow to embody old, wise and live with faith, good character and purpose.

In the Christian tradition, Aldis represents the pursuit of wisdom, knowledge, and understanding, and the ability to perceive and interpret the world around us.
